In [[combinatorial data analysis]], '''seriation''' is the process of finding an arrangement of all objects in a set, in a [[linear order]], given a [[loss function]].<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.18637/jss.v025.i03 |title=Getting Things in Order: An Introduction to the R Package seriation |journal=Journal of Statistical Software |volume=25 |issue=3 |year=2008 |last1=Hahsler |first1=Michael |last2=Hornik |first2=Kurt |last3=Buchta |first3=Christian|doi-access=free }}</ref> The main goal is exploratory, to reveal structural information.
